what_it_shows: Each owner's description of the service, its dependencies, its manual fallback, and the longest outage and data loss the divisions can tolerate. The Group identity director states that the 1-hour identity RTO was met in two tests in 2026 and that break-glass accounts for critical systems are tested every quarter

title: Tax and Advisory and CPA Partners: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Chief Tax Officer, Tax division operations director, Tax division technology director, client accounting services director, CPA Partners managing partner)
owner: Tax division security and compliance lead
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, its deadlines, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate. Owners give peak-season values (mid-January to April 15 and October 1 to 15) and say that outside those windows preparation and e-file can wait 72 hours. Signed returns can queue and be released in bulk when the gateway returns. Without AI-001, preparation slows by about 15% in season

title: Practice Cloud: group legal position memo, 2026-06-10
source_system: Group legal files
what_it_shows: Practice Cloud is a service provider to its customer firms under 16 CFR 314.4(f) and a third-party agent under state breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) as the worked example). It treats itself as a tax return preparer providing auxiliary services for IRC 7216 (26 CFR 301.7216-1(b)(2)(i)(B)), receiving information under 301.7216-2(d)(1). It is not treated as a financial institution; counsel revisits this if it begins to move client funds itself

title: Control assessment: Common control (SYS-G1): account management (AC-2)
source_system: Identity governance configuration; joiner-mover-leaver sample (60 events across all divisions); 2026 seasonal account report (about 11,000 accounts); group identity director interview
what_it_shows: Identity governance configuration and a joiner-mover-leaver sample of 60 events across all divisions processed with approvals. In the 2026 seasonal account report (about 11,000 accounts), 14% of seasonal accounts were enabled before the background check and training conditions were met, and seasonal accounts were disabled an average of 9 days after the season ended. Season end is not sent from HR as a termination event. Office managers extended 1,240 seasonal accounts in the application without an HR authorization

title: Control assessment: Common control (SYS-G1): identification and authentication (IA-2)

The 2019 exception has no Qualified Individual approval on record
